hook_text: EXMPL is up 29% today. The business is not.
audio_script: EXMPL is up twenty nine percent today, on five times average volume, so the internet has decided it is a technology company again. [PLATE: hook-card-t1 | ticker=EXMPL | move=+29% | hook=a plateau in a costume | sub=on five times volume] [BEAT] The news is an AI partnership. A press release, not a purchase order, and nobody has attached a revenue number to it yet. Plus squeeze chatter, because eleven percent of the float was betting against it. [DRY] Gut check. I read the filings so you don't have to. [PLATE: numbers-sheet-4r-9x16 | unit=$M | head=FY21,FY22,FY23,FY24,FY25,LTM | label-1=Revenue | row-1=400,431,458,472,486,496 | label-2=Net income | row-2=-8,-25,-49,-70,-89,-94 | label-3=Free cash flow | row-3=12,-3,-31,-52,-68,-71 | label-4=Share count | row-4=298,312,328,344,358,365 | band=2] Revenue went four hundred million to four ninety six in six years, which is growth you need a magnifying glass to find. Losses got [SCRIBBLE: scrawl-oval-tight -> Net income] wider every single year, and ninety four million went out the door last time. Free cash flow turned negative in twenty twenty two and stayed there. [PLATE: big-number-l1-9x16 | kicker=FREE CASH FLOW, LTM | value=-$71M | label=the fourth negative year running | caption=From the filing] Then the share count. Two hundred and ninety eight million shares became three hundred and sixty five, which is how management quietly sends you the bill. [PLATE: compare-stacked-9x16 | kicker=SHARE COUNT | label-1=FY21 | value-1=298M | label-2=LTM | value-2=365M | delta=+22% | caption=Dilution is a cost with no line item] [SIGH] Eleven times earnings, and every number underneath it is going the wrong way. Cheap only counts if the sliding stops. The chart went vertical. The business went sideways. [BEAT] Noise. A press release and a squeeze, stapled to six years of drift. [PLATE: closing-9x16 | kicker=THE CLOSE | line-1=The chart went vertical. | line-2=The business went sideways. | line-3=Set a reminder for the next 10-Q. | date-label=Next filing | date=14 May] Set a reminder for the next 10-Q.

headlines.meaning: A partnership headline, not a purchase order
11% of the float is short. The crowd noticed and piled in.

numbers_comment: Revenue flat for three years, losses widening every year, share count up six percent a year. Business sideways; stock vertical.
cheap_or_trap: Cheap only counts if the sliding stops.
turn_line: A press release, not a purchase order.
conclusion: Noise. A press release and a squeeze, stapled to six years of drift. Set a reminder for the next 10-Q.
